verdict.rationale: Loops explicitly markets seeing 'which emails lead to upgrades, lower churn, and add revenue' with dynamic segments, suggesting some revenue/conversion attribution beyond opens/clicks, but this is a single marketing-page claim with no detail on methodology, dashboards, or per-flow attribution granularity, and no independent or hands-on corroboration exists in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how revenue/signup attribution is computed, screenshots or hands-on reports of attribution reporting, and third-party validation.
